en.description: The prescription-free hearing aids worth buying in 2026, ranked by speech-in-noise performance, hearing loss range, fitting support, battery and streaming, comfort, and value.

zh-tw.title: 2026 最佳 OTC 助聽器排行榜
zh-tw.description: 2026 年真正值得買的免處方箋助聽器，用吵雜環境語音辨識、適用聽損範圍、驗配與售後支援、續航與串流、配戴舒適度、性價比實測分級。

en.description: A self-fitting receiver-in-canal aid that scored 4.78 out of 5 on HearAdvisor's SoundScore, the highest grade in the OTC category, with AI noise handling, Bluetooth streaming, audiogram upload, and free video calls with licensed audiologists built into the app.

zh-tw.description: 耳掛受話器分離式（RIC）設計，HearAdvisor 實驗室 SoundScore 拿到 4.78 分，是整個 OTC 品類目前的最高分，AI 降噪、藍牙串流、上傳聽力圖自動配置一次到位，App 裡還能免費跟聽力師視訊調機。

en.description: The service-heavy option: three years of unlimited remote fine-tuning by licensed audiologists, a 100-day return window, a three-year warranty, and rechargeable RIC hardware from a hearing brand that has been shipping since 2019.

zh-tw.description: 主打服務的機種，三年無限次聽力師遠端調機、100 天無條件退貨、三年保固全包，硬體是充電式 RIC，Jabra 從 2019 年做到現在，是這份榜單裡售後體系最完整的一家。

en.description: An in-the-canal earbud-style aid that earned an A grade with a 4.47 SoundScore at HearAdvisor, using soft ear-wings to stay comfortable past ten hours of continuous wear and running about 13.5 hours per charge in hearing mode.

zh-tw.description: 耳道內（ITC）耳塞造型，HearAdvisor 給 A 等級、SoundScore 4.47 分，軟矽膠翼撐住耳廓，連續戴超過十小時耳道不會脹痛，純助聽模式一次充電大約撐 13.5 小時。

en.description: Earbuds carrying FDA-authorized OTC hearing aid software at no extra cost, set up through a five-minute iPhone hearing test, with active noise cancellation, Transparency mode, and roughly 10 hours of listening per charge.

zh-tw.description: 取得 FDA 授權的 OTC 助聽軟體直接內建，不用另外付費，用 iPhone 做五分鐘聽力測試就完成設定，主動降噪、通透模式照樣能用，單次充電大約 10 小時。

en.description: The entry tier of Jabra's care model, keeping the rechargeable RIC form factor and the audiologist support package at half the price of the Select 700, with the same 100-day trial window.

zh-tw.description: Jabra 服務型方案的入門款，一樣是充電式 RIC 加聽力師支援，價格只有 Select 700 的一半，100 天試用期完全相同，想要有人幫忙調機又不想花到六萬台幣的人可以從這台開始。

en.description: A self-fitting RIC aid tuned by an audio brand, delivering the strongest music streaming scores in the OTC category and near-perfect feedback suppression, sold through Best Buy and major retail alongside the online channel.

zh-tw.description: 音響品牌調音的自助驗配 RIC 機種，音樂串流表現是 OTC 品類裡最好的一批，回授抑制幾乎滿分，戴著講電話或聽音樂都很安靜，在美國走 Best Buy 這類實體通路，可以現場試戴再決定。

en.description: A rechargeable RIC aid with Bose-tuned acoustics and a wireless charging case, self-fitted through the Lexie app and stocked at Costco and Best Buy; parent company LXE Hearing began winding down US operations on July 15, 2026, with support committed through September 15, 2026.

zh-tw.description: 充電式 RIC，聲學由 Bose 調校，附無線充電盒，用 Lexie App 自助驗配，美國在 Costco 與 Best Buy 都買得到；母公司 LXE Hearing 已於 2026 年 7 月 15 日啟動美國業務收尾，客服與保固承諾到 2026 年 9 月 15 日。

en.description: A tiny rechargeable completely-in-canal aid built around simplicity, with preset listening programs you cycle through on the device itself and US-based phone support staffed by hearing professionals.

zh-tw.description: 極小的深耳道式充電機種，主打簡單好上手，內建幾組情境預設，直接在機身上切換就好，另外提供美國本地的專人電話諮詢，很適合買給習慣用實體按鍵的長輩。

en.description: The touchscreen-charging-case budget pick, scoring 2.98 out of 5 on HearAdvisor's SoundScore with straightforward amplification, four sound modes, and a rechargeable case that shows battery and volume on a small display.

zh-tw.description: 平價段的觸控充電盒機種，HearAdvisor SoundScore 2.98 分，走的是單純放大路線，四種聲音模式，充電盒上有小螢幕直接顯示電量跟音量，操作邏輯很直覺。

en.description: The most discreet aid here, sitting entirely inside the ear canal with Premium Environmental Adaptation for music, calls and TV; parent company LXE Hearing began winding down US operations on July 15, 2026, with support committed through September 15, 2026.

zh-tw.description: 這份榜單裡最隱形的一台，整顆塞進耳道外觀完全看不出來，內建情境自動適應會針對音樂、通話、電視切換；母公司 LXE Hearing 已於 2026 年 7 月 15 日啟動美國業務收尾，客服與保固承諾到 2026 年 9 月 15 日。

references.title: Best Hearing Aids by Sound Performance in 2026
An Audiologist's Guide to the Best OTC Hearing Aids of 2026
Reviewed: AirPods Pro 3 as Hearing Aids
Eargo Hearing Aids: Models, Features, Prices, and Reviews

en.commentary: The ELEHEAR Beyond Pro is my pick for 2026, and the margin is wider than I expected when I started ranking these. It posts a 4.78 out of 5 SoundScore in HearAdvisor's lab, the top result in the entire OTC category, and it does that at $599. Four years into the FDA's OTC pathway, the assumption that sound quality tracks price has finally broken, and this is the device that broke it. You get a receiver-in-canal shell, audiogram-based programming you can submit remotely, Bluetooth streaming, and free video sessions with licensed audiologists, which is the exact feature set that used to cost two thousand dollars. Jabra's Enhance Select 700 holds second at $1,995 because three years of unlimited remote fine-tuning is worth real money to anyone with asymmetric loss or a complicated audiogram, and Jabra is the one brand here I trust to still be answering the phone in 2029. That last point matters more this year than it ever has. LXE Hearing, which owns Eargo, Lexie and Go Hearing, started winding down its US operations on July 15, 2026, and has only committed to support through September 15. Sony left the category earlier this year when its partnership with WS Audiology ended. Two of the biggest names in prescription-free hearing are now exit risks, and I have ranked them accordingly: a hearing aid is a three-to-five year purchase, and the company behind it needs to outlast the warranty. Meanwhile Apple's AirPods Pro 3 at $249 have quietly become the most consequential product on this list, because they put an FDA-authorized hearing aid in the ears of people who would never have searched for one.

highlights.title: A $599 hearing aid now beats a $2,699 one on measured sound quality, and that ends the price-equals-performance era
highlights.body: The ELEHEAR Beyond Pro scores 4.78 out of 5 on HearAdvisor's SoundScore, an A grade and the highest result in the OTC category, while the Eargo 8 sits at $2,699 and sells on invisibility. HearAdvisor runs standardized acoustic measurements on a head-and-torso simulator, so these numbers are directly comparable across brands in a way that marketing copy never is. When the cheapest serious RIC device in the category also produces the best speech-in-noise result, the shopping heuristic that most buyers arrive with, spend more and hear better, stops working. My advice for 2026 is to start at $599 and only move up if you need something the Beyond Pro genuinely lacks, which for most people with mild to moderate loss is nothing at all.

highlights.title: Buy from a company that will still exist when your warranty matters, because two major brands just proved this is a real risk
highlights.body: LXE Hearing began winding down its US operations on July 15, 2026, and has committed to customer service and warranty processing only through September 15, 2026. That covers Eargo, Lexie Hearing and Go Hearing in one stroke, three brands that between them held enormous share of the prescription-free market. Sony's exit came earlier in 2026 when its partnership with WS Audiology ended and all three CRE models disappeared from Sony's US site. Hearing aids need firmware updates, replacement domes and wax guards, app maintenance and battery service across a three to five year life. I have scored aftercare heavily this cycle, which is why Jabra sits second despite costing more than three times the winner, and why the Eargo 8 lands tenth despite being the most comfortable device I would recommend to anyone who cares about invisibility.

highlights.title: AirPods Pro 3 are the best $249 anyone with early hearing loss can spend, and Apple deserves credit for the reach
highlights.body: Apple's hearing aid feature is FDA-authorized, free in software, set up with a five-minute hearing test on an iPhone, and now live in more than 100 countries and regions. For someone in the first stage of age-related loss, still telling themselves the television is just quiet, that combination removes every barrier that used to stand between them and amplification: no clinic visit, no stigma, no separate purchase. Independent testing shows the amplification handles conversation well and gets harder to rely on in genuine background noise, and battery tops out around 10 hours, so I treat this as a first device on a two-year horizon. It is still the highest-impact product in the category, because the biggest problem in hearing health has always been the seven-year gap between noticing loss and doing something about it.

highlights.title: Pay the Jabra premium only if your audiogram is complicated, and know exactly what the extra $1,400 buys
highlights.body: The Enhance Select 700 costs $1,995 against the Beyond Pro's $599, and the entire gap is service: three years of unlimited remote fine-tuning by licensed audiologists, a 100-day return window, and a three-year warranty. That is a strong offer for asymmetric loss, for a steep high-frequency slope, or for anyone who has already tried self-fitting and given up. It is also worth it for a buyer purchasing on behalf of a parent who will not troubleshoot an app. For a straightforward mild-to-moderate audiogram on someone comfortable with a smartphone, the Beyond Pro covers the same ground, and the Enhance Select 50R at $995 splits the difference by keeping the audiologist package at half the flagship price.

highlights.title: Match the form factor to the failure mode you actually care about, since RIC and in-canal solve different problems
highlights.body: Receiver-in-canal devices, which covers the Beyond Pro, both Jabras, the Sennheiser and the Lexie, put the speaker in the ear canal and the processor behind the ear. That layout gives more amplification headroom, longer battery life and room for larger microphones, at the cost of a visible module behind the ear. In-the-canal devices like the ELEHEAR Delight, MDHearing NEO XS and Eargo 8 disappear from view and win on all-day comfort, with the Delight rated for more than ten hours of continuous wear on soft ear-wings. The real question is which constraint governs your life. If discretion is what decides whether you wear them at all, then an in-canal device you put in every morning is the one that gives you your hearing back.

zh-tw.commentary:
ELEHEAR Beyond Pro 是我 2026 年的首選，而且差距比我一開始排的時候預期的還大。它在 HearAdvisor 實驗室的 SoundScore 拿到 4.78 分，是整個 OTC 品類的最高分，售價只要 599 美元，換算下來不到兩萬台幣。

說真的，FDA 開放免處方箋助聽器四年之後，「越貴聽得越清楚」這個假設終於被打破了，打破它的就是這台。RIC 架構、可以遠端上傳聽力圖自動配置、藍牙串流、App 裡免費跟聽力師視訊，這一整套功能三年前要價六萬起跳。

Jabra Enhance Select 700 排第二，1,995 美元的定價買的是三年無限次聽力師遠端調機。如果你兩耳聽損差很多，或是高頻掉得很陡，這筆錢值得付，而且 Jabra 是這份榜單裡我最有把握 2029 年還會接電話的品牌。

這一點今年格外重要。擁有 Eargo、Lexie、Go Hearing 三個品牌的 LXE Hearing 在 2026 年 7 月 15 日啟動美國業務收尾，客服只承諾到 9 月 15 日。Sony 也在今年稍早跟 WS Audiology 拆夥退出這個市場。免處方箋助聽器最大的兩個名字同時變成退場風險，我在評分上直接反映了這件事，助聽器是要用三到五年的東西，賣你的公司必須活得比保固久。

另一邊，249 美元的 AirPods Pro 3 悄悄變成這份清單上影響力最大的產品，因為它把 FDA 授權的助聽功能塞進了一群根本不會去搜尋助聽器的人耳朵裡。

highlights.title: 兩萬不到的機種在實測音質上贏過八萬七的機種，價格等於效能的時代結束了
highlights.body: ELEHEAR Beyond Pro 在 HearAdvisor 的 SoundScore 拿到 4.78 分、A 等級，是 OTC 品類的最高分，而 Eargo 8 標價 2,699 美元、換算超過八萬台幣，賣的是隱形度。HearAdvisor 用頭部與軀幹模擬器做標準化聲學量測，所以這些數字跨品牌可以直接比，這是官網文案永遠給不了的東西。當品類裡最便宜的正規 RIC 機種同時做出最好的吵雜環境語音表現，多數人買助聽器時帶著的那套「多花點錢聽得更清楚」的直覺就失效了。我 2026 年的建議很單純，從 599 美元這一階開始，除非 Beyond Pro 真的缺了你需要的功能再往上加，而對輕度到中度聽損的人來說，通常什麼都不缺。

highlights.title: 挑一家保固到期前不會消失的公司，今年已經有兩個大品牌證明這是真實風險
highlights.body: LXE Hearing 在 2026 年 7 月 15 日啟動美國業務收尾，客服與保固受理只承諾到 2026 年 9 月 15 日，一次涵蓋 Eargo、Lexie Hearing、Go Hearing 三個品牌，這三家加起來曾經佔掉免處方箋市場非常大的一塊。Sony 的退場更早，今年跟 WS Audiology 結束合作之後，三款 CRE 機型全數從美國官網下架。助聽器在三到五年的使用週期裡需要韌體更新、耳塞與耳垢濾網補給、App 持續維護、電池服務，這些全都綁在原廠身上。所以我這一輪把售後支援的權重拉得很高，這也是 Jabra 貴到冠軍三倍還能排第二、Eargo 8 舒適度我給到 9.8 分卻只能排第十的原因。

highlights.title: AirPods Pro 3 是輕度聽損的人最值得花的七千五，Apple 這一步的覆蓋率值得肯定
highlights.body: Apple 的助聽功能拿到 FDA 授權、軟體免費內建、用 iPhone 做五分鐘聽力測試就完成設定，目前已經開放到 100 個以上的國家與地區。對一個剛開始老化性聽損、還在跟自己說「是電視聲音太小」的人來說，這個組合把過去擋在他跟放大聲音之間的每一道門檻都拆掉了，不用跑聽力所、沒有被貼標籤的心理負擔、也不用多買一台裝置。獨立實測顯示它處理一般對話沒問題，真的到吵雜環境就比較吃力，續航大約 10 小時，所以我會把它定位成用個一兩年的入門機。即便如此，它仍然是這個品類影響力最大的產品，因為聽力健康最大的問題一直都是從察覺聽損到真正處理之間那七年的空窗。

highlights.title: 只有聽力圖複雜的人才需要付 Jabra 這個溢價，你要清楚多花的四萬多買到什麼
highlights.body: Enhance Select 700 賣 1,995 美元，Beyond Pro 賣 599 美元，中間那四萬多台幣的差距全部都是服務，三年無限次聽力師遠端調機、100 天無條件退貨、三年保固。兩耳聽損不對稱、高頻曲線掉得很陡、或是自己調過一次就放棄的人，這個方案很值得。幫爸媽買、而爸媽不可能自己去研究 App 的情況也適用。坦白講，如果只是單純的輕中度聽損、使用者本身用手機沒障礙，Beyond Pro 覆蓋的範圍完全一樣，而 995 美元的 Enhance Select 50R 剛好卡在中間，用旗艦一半的價格保留同一套聽力師服務。

highlights.title: 先想清楚你真正在意的是什麼，RIC 跟耳道內解決的是兩種不同的問題
highlights.body: 受話器分離式（RIC）機種包含 Beyond Pro、兩台 Jabra、Sennheiser 跟 Lexie，喇叭放進耳道、處理器掛在耳後，這個配置換來更大的放大餘裕、更長的續航、更大的麥克風空間，代價是耳後會看到一顆模組。耳道內機種像 ELEHEAR Delight、MDHearing NEO XS、Eargo 8 外觀完全看不出來，勝在全天配戴的舒適度，Delight 靠軟矽膠翼可以連續戴超過十小時。真正該問的是哪個限制在支配你的生活。如果外觀顧慮會決定你要不要戴出門，那麼一台你每天早上都願意戴上的耳道內機種，才是真正能把聽力還給你的那台。
